description: Discover all the charm of Paris from this exceptional apartment, ideally located just steps from Avenue Montaigne and the Champs-Élysées. This superb two-bedroom apartment offers a spacious layout that can accommodate up to 7 guests and features two bathrooms. You will enjoy a fully equipped kitchen, a washing machine, a dryer, and elevator access. Perfect for families, the apartment is designed to ensure a comfortable and unforgettable stay.
